_comment: 0.8.28 Slice 41 unit Q cross-SDK fixture (REQ41-Q6, AC41-36, AC41-38, AC41-40). The corpus, queries and expected ids are written by hand; the ids follow from which documents share a non-stop content token with the query (FTS5 bm25, OR semantics), and the order from the number of matched terms. Hashes are SHA-256 of the effective words sorted by Unicode scalar value and joined by newline, computed independently with Python hashlib. Score bits are deliberately not stored: each SDK compares the configured engine's scores with its own default engine queried with the words stripped (the harness transform).

queries.query: how long had the dentist suggest flossing
queries._derivation: Default terms long, had, dentist, suggest, flossing ('how', 'the' are built-in stop words): s41q-a matches three terms, s41q-b two, so a ranks first. With the setting the terms are dentist, flossing: only s41q-b matches.
Default terms suggest, garden, plan ('a' is a built-in stop word): s41q-c matches two terms, s41q-a one. With the setting the terms are garden, plan: only s41q-c matches.
